column1: # Communes whose Wikidata Corsican label (sources/places.tsv) is a redirect in the Corsican Vikipedia dump of 2026-10-16:
# the article has another title. Candidates only, NOT checked: some titles are another name of the same commune
# (Vizzani, now in sources/place-titles.tsv), others are an accented spelling, a fuller name, a hamlet or a mistaken
# redirect (Mela -> "Mela (malus domestica)"). A title moves to sources/place-titles.tsv only after a check by hand.
